column4: toolchain-gated: the cleat#3786 worker test builds a real Python component with componentize-py (and needs a database), which THIS job does not install. Python is tier 1, and its toolchain is provisioned by the tier-1 Gate's rest shard and by e2e-cross-language.yml -- not by test-go/commands. The gate is legitimate rather than convenient: buildPythonExample calls t.Fatalf, not t.Skip, when CLEAT_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAINS names python, so a job that PROMISES the toolchain cannot silently skip this. One whole test; the subtests are reached only after the toolchain check, so they do not skip separately.
